chunks: And with this chain, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskhan, from Zurarah, from one of the Imams (peace be upon him), he said:
The divorced woman inherits and is inherited from until she sees the third blood [of menstruation]; when she sees it, then it is severed.

key_terms.الْمُطَلَّقَةُ: The divorced woman (specifically in the context of waiting period)

ai.seo_question: When does a divorced woman's right to inherit from her ex-husband end according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies the duration of the 'iddah' for a divorced woman by linking the termination of mutual inheritance rights to the occurrence of the third menstrual period, a key indicator of the end of the waiting period in Shia jurisprudence. It underscores the practical legal implication that inheritance rights are contingent upon the active state of 'iddah', which concludes definitively upon this third menstruation.
